title: Stochastic ruler and calibration gate for the native witness (P-RET, P-CAL): specification for preregistration
objective: Specify the P-RET statistic, alpha, sample size, no-carry bound and INDETERMINATE band, and the P-CAL calibration gate (SHUF/NULL at the bound within margin; POS detected), as the evidence-plane sign-off DESIGN_DRAFT s8.1 asks for; implement them as pure functions with tests on synthetic data only.
parent_objective: native witness preparation (opens as its own campaign only if C-009 closes)
problem: A balanced binary target gives 1/2 per post-interrupt step under no carry; choose a registered test (e.g. exact binomial on per-episode decisions, or a permutation test over seeds) with power stated for the planned n, and an INDETERMINATE band so the ruler cannot be forced to POSITIVE or NEGATIVE at an underpowered n. Power/size calculations on SYNTHETIC data are allowed; no Ares output may be used.
non_goals: No subject evolution; no witness predicate; no retention or accuracy statistic for any arm or control (SELECTION.md gate)
No edit of ares/ sources (adapter-side wrappers only)
No change to rso/binding or the slice evidence plane (BX6)
evidence_required: RULER.md with statistic, alpha, n, bound, band, power at stated effect sizes
ruler.py tests on synthetic data incl. size check under the null

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; no outcome observed
